title: The bring-up guidebook
what: Every step in the order a bring-up meets them, a chapter per stage: what done means, what it needs and enables, the proof, the helper or the gap, how it is done and the traps met, the sources, and the world gaps marked.

title: The bring-up graph
what: The steps drawn as a graph from the database: a goal on the left, what it needs growing to the right, a tab per phone colouring each step by what its base claims, and a click to read a step and fold what it needs.

title: The steps against each phone
what: Every step a row and each phone a column, with its status, proof and run on hover, and how many steps toward each goal each phone has done.

title: The steps table
what: The bring-up steps as rows, as tad renders them: stage, applies, done when, proof, helper, guide and sources.

title: What each phone's base claims
what: The claims each device base makes per step, pulled into docs: status, proof, run and what it was proven on.
